name: Queen Kerala Spa and Massage
headline: Queen Kerala Spa
lede: Ayurvedic massage combines the 5,000-year-old Indian principles of Ayurveda—the science of life—and pressure points.
about: Ayurvedic massage combines the 5,000-year-old Indian principles of Ayurveda—the science of life—and pressure points. This type of massage is designed to create balance among the mind, body, and spirit, and help the body heal itself.
